title: New [platform_requires]  similar to system-tools, but for all requires
body:
Changelog: Feature: New ``[platform_requires]`` profile definition to be able to replace Conan dependencies by platform-provided dependencies.
Changelog: Fix: Deprecate ``[system_tools]`` in favor of ``[platform_tool_requires]`` to align with ``[platform_requires]`` for regular dependencies. Changed output from "System tool" to "Platform".
Docs: https://github.com/conan-io/docs/pull/3495


Close https://github.com/conan-io/conan/issues/14566
Address https://github.com/conan-io/conan/issues/15001
Close https://github.com/conan-io/conan/issues/15101
Close https://github.com/conan-io/conan/issues/1330

TO LOOK INTO:
- Renamed to ``[system_requires]``, I didn't like ``[system_deps]``, but still not convinced because of overlap with ``system_requirements()``
- The cases of replacement of a requires with another Conan recipe, more like override, needs to be treated in a different way
- Some generalization of "System tool" => "System requirement" is needed, but lets agree on the naming first
